messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates C++ code to Python 3 code. The code should reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
n, d, max_iter = map(int, input().split())
ratio = n / d
a_candidate = 1
b_candidate = 1
if d <= b_candidate:
    print(f"{n}/{d}")
else:
    min_diff = 1e9
    epsilon = 1e-25
    for i in range(1, max_iter + 1):
        val = ratio * i
        a1 = int(val // 1)
        a2 = a1 + 1
        current_diff = abs(ratio - a1 / i)
        if current_diff < min_diff - epsilon:
            min_diff = current_diff
            a_candidate = a1
            b_candidate = i
        current_diff = abs(a2 / i - ratio)
        if current_diff < min_diff - epsilon:
            min_diff = current_diff
            a_candidate = a2
            b_candidate = i
    print(f"{a_candidate}/{b_candidate}")
